scene_prompt: Create a bright, colourful cartoon-style 3D minigame map titled “Mini Game.” Build a small, neat central lobby hub with clearly separated entrances leading to three simple activity zones: an obby/parkour course, a short race track, and a basic combat arena. Arrange the lobby as the connecting center, with the three game areas visible around it and clear paths between them.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Party & Casual: this is a social minigame collection with a shared lobby and several short activities. Obby & Platformer is secondary because one activity is a dedicated parkour course; the race and combat spaces remain compact minigame zones within the party layout.

### Shape and preset
Use the continuous shared-space shape `space-continuous`, with the lobby and all three activity areas visible together and connected on one map. The closest preset is Minigame, but its isolated-stage `space-staged` structure contradicts the requested open, visible-around-the-hub arrangement, so the preset is none.

### Config requirements
Use visible `social-hub` geometry: a small, tidy central lobby square that distributes players to each activity entrance. No unrequested leaderboard, teleporter, scoring volume, shop geometry, pickups, or NPC population should be added. The three activity zones are visible geometry; their gameplay triggers, spawns, scoring, and administrative systems are invisible and must not appear in the render.

### Layout components
Place a compact central lobby hub in the middle, large enough for gathering but smaller than the combined activity ring. Give it three clearly signed, evenly separated entrances and broad, unobstructed paved paths radiating outward. Put the obby/parkour course on one side as a short, readable chain of colourful raised platforms, ramps, and safe landings. Place the short race track on another side as a compact, clearly continuous loop or out-and-back route with a visible start and finish area. Put the basic combat arena on the third side as a simple open circular or square floor with low boundary walls and a few sparse cover blocks. Keep all three zones visually distinct by colour and silhouette while preserving direct sightlines back to the lobby. Use flat cartoon ground, with no water, buildings, or terrain relief requested. Frame the whole map in an isometric three-quarter view with the lobby central and the three zones forming a clean three-pronged composition.

### Render order
Use `topdown`: the parkour sequence and short race route must remain connected and playable, so their topology should be planned before the isometric dressing.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, driven by one lobby plus three complete but short activity zones. Theme: bright, colourful, polished Roblox-style cartoon minigame park. Use `P6` because the obby route and race route need valid, continuous construction; no other geometry forces an added pipeline pass.
